goal: Verify that a user can create a new account, navigate the calendar to the previous month, and successfully create a memo with specific content.

findings.instruction: In the text input area labeled 'Any thoughts...', type the message 'Team meeting at 3 PM to discuss Q3 goals.' and click the 'Save' button.
findings.title: Calendar unexpectedly reverted from May 2026 to June 2026 during memo creation step
findings.description: The calendar was correctly showing 'May 2026' after Step 1. However, in the AFTER screenshot of Step 2, the calendar displays 'June 2026' even though the intended action was to type a memo and click Save. The memo creation action did not execute (automation failure), yet the calendar state changed unexpectedly, indicating a potential application logic issue where the calendar reverts or resets without user interaction.
findings.evidence: BEFORE screenshot shows 'May 2026' in the calendar header. AFTER screenshot shows 'June 2026' in the calendar header. No user action was performed to navigate the calendar forward, and the memo input remains empty, confirming the state change was unintended.
reproduction_steps: Log in and navigate to the dashboard.
Click the 'Previous month' button to display May 2026.
Attempt to type a memo (even if automation fails), observe that the calendar unexpectedly changes to June 2026.
